```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
  function(df, id_col, date_col = "eingangsdatum") {
    df %>% group_by(across(all_of(id_col))) %>% slice_max(order_by = across(all_of(date_col)),
                                                          n = 1,
                                                          with_ties = FALSE)
  }
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=9, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# define disease groups
dg_alsftd <- function(x) {
  if (x %in% c("ALS","FTD","ALS/FTD")) {
    return("ALS/FTD")
  } else if (x %in% c("4R_Tau")) {
    return("4R_Tau")
  } else if (x %in% c("AD","LBD","NPH","AD/LBD")) {
    return("DC")
  } else {
    return("NCA")
  }
}
df$dg_alsftd <- sapply(df$diagnosis_label, dg_alsftd) %>% factor(levels = c("ALS/FTD","4R_Tau","DC","NCA"))
```

```{r fig.height=14, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}}
# Numeric conversion
to_numeric <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub(",", ".", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Only convert existing columns
existing_features <- features[features %in% names(dat)]
dat <- dat %>% mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), to_numeric))

# Helper: 1-vs-all stats
one_vs_all <- function(df, var, group_col) {
  d <- df %>% select(all_of(group_col), all_of(var)) %>% drop_na()
  if(nrow(d) < 6) return(tibble(group=character(), var=var, p=NA_real_, q=NA_real_))
  levs <- d %>% pull(all_of(group_col)) %>% as.factor() %>% levels()
  res <- lapply(levs, function(g) {
    x <- d %>% filter(.data[[group_col]] == g) %>% pull(all_of(var))
    y <- d %>% filter(.data[[group_col]] != g) %>% pull(all_of(var))
    if(length(x) < 3 || length(y) < 5) return(tibble(group=g, var=var, p=NA_real_))
    pval <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value, error=function(e) NA_real_)
    tibble(group=g, var=var, p=pval)
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  res %>% mutate(q = p.adjust(p, method="BH"))
}

stats_by <- function(df, vars, group_col) {
  bind_rows(lapply(vars, function(v) one_vs_all(df, v, group_col))) %>%
    mutate(grouping = group_col)
}

# Aggregation to matrices
agg_matrix <- function(df, vars, group_col, fun = median) {
  df %>%
    select(all_of(group_col), all_of(vars)) %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
    summarize(across(all_of(vars), ~fun(.x, na.rm=TRUE)), .groups="drop") %>%
    column_to_rownames(group_col) %>%
    t() %>%
    as.matrix()
}

# Scale rows
scale_rows <- function(m) {
  m2 <- t(scale(t(m)))
  m2[is.na(m2)] <- 0
  m2
}

nice_row_names <- function(vars) {
  nms <- pretty_names[vars]
  nms <- ifelse(is.na(nms), vars, nms)
  unname(nms)
}

# Build heatmap function with black boxes around variable blocks
build_heatmap <- function(group_col, file_pdf) {
  vars_present <- existing_features
  st <- stats_by(dat, vars_present, group_col)
  mat <- agg_matrix(dat, vars_present, group_col, median)
  zmat <- scale_rows(mat)

  # Asterisk matrix
  q_tab <- st %>%
    select(group, var, q) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = q, values_fill = NA) %>%
    column_to_rownames("var")

  q_tab <- q_tab[rownames(zmat), colnames(zmat), drop=FALSE]

  stars_from_q <- function(q) {
    if(is.na(q)) return("")
    if(q < 0.001) return("***")
    if(q < 0.01)  return("**")
    if(q < 0.05)  return("*")
    ""
  }

  star_mat <- matrix("", nrow=nrow(zmat), ncol=ncol(zmat), dimnames = dimnames(zmat))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(zmat))) {
    for(j in seq_len(ncol(zmat))) {
      star_mat[i,j] <- stars_from_q(q_tab[i,j])
    }
  }

  # Row order and blocks
  row_order <- rownames(zmat)
  row_block <- case_when(
    row_order %in% demo ~ "Demo",
    row_order %in% csf_vars ~ "CSF",
    row_order %in% mri_vars ~ "MRI",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )

  # Row annotation
  ha_rows <- rowAnnotation(
    Block = factor(row_block, levels = c("Demo","CSF","MRI","Other")),
    col = list(Block = c(Demo="grey80", CSF="grey40", MRI="grey10", Other="#d9d9d9")),
    width = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

  # Colors
  col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#004c4c","#f7f7f7","#de7a00"))

  # Heatmap with black boxes around each row split block
  ht <- Heatmap(
    zmat,
    name = "Z-score",
    col = col_fun,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    row_order = row_order,
    column_title = paste(ifelse(group_col == "diagnosis_label", "Diagnoses", "Diagnoses Grouped")),
    row_labels = nice_row_names(rownames(zmat)),
    row_split = factor(row_block, levels = c("Demo","CSF","MRI","Other")),
    row_gap = unit(3, "mm"),  
    rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.5),
    border = TRUE,  
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
      lab <- star_mat[i, j]
      if(nchar(lab) > 0) {
        grid::grid.text(lab, x = x, y = y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black", fontface = "bold"))
      }
    }
  )

  
  pdf(file_pdf, width = ifelse(group_col == "diagnosis_label",4,3.5), height = 10)
  draw(ha_rows + ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
  dev.off()

  cat("Saved:", file_pdf, "\n")
}


# Generate both heatmaps
build_heatmap("diagnosis_label", "Figures/heatmap_diagnosis_label_stars.pdf")
build_heatmap("dg_alsftd", "Figures/heatmap_dg_alsftd_stars.pdf")
```

# 5 ALS/FTD Models

## 5.1 Regularized XGBoost with Feature Selection

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
# ====================================================================
# ALS/FTD CLASSIFICATION WITH IMPROVED REGULARIZATION
# ====================================================================
# IMPLEMENTED:
# 1. Proper MICE imputation - test set imputed using training parameters
# 2. Strong regularization - lambda (L2), alpha (L1), gamma penalties
# 3. Conservative hyperparameters - shallow trees (depth 2-3), low eta
# 4. Balanced model selection - penalizes train-test gap in scoring
# 
# EXPECTED OUTCOME: balanced AUC / generalization to unseen data
# ====================================================================

library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(foreach)
library(glmnet)

#===== HELPER FUNCTIONS =====
calc_metrics <- function(y_true, y_pred_prob, threshold = 0.5) {
  y_pred <- ifelse(y_pred_prob > threshold, 1, 0)
  cm <- confusionMatrix(factor(y_pred, levels = c(0, 1)), 
                        factor(y_true, levels = c(0, 1)), 
                        positive = "1")
  roc_obj <- roc(y_true, y_pred_prob, quiet = TRUE)
  
  list(
    Accuracy = as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]),
    Sensitivity = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    Specificity = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]),
    F1 = as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"]),
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)),
    Precision = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"])
  )
}

# ===== STEP 1: PREPARE DATA & SPLIT =====
df$alsftd_binary <- ifelse(df$dg_alsftd == "ALS/FTD", 1, 0)
feature_cols_mri <- df %>% 
  select_if(is.numeric) %>% 
  select(
    -alsftd_binary, -rn, -time_to_event, -manifestation_year, # demographics
    -alsfrs_score, -updrs_3_score, -edss_score, -mmse_score_1, -moca_score_2, -mmse_score_2,
    -medication_cognitive, -medication_parkinsonian, -medication_antidepressants, -medication_antipsychotics, -onset_lp_time,
    -igaif_ig_a_if
   ) %>% 
  names()

set.seed(456)  
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(df$alsftd_binary, p = 0.75, list = FALSE)
X_train_raw<- as.matrix(df[trainIndex, feature_cols_mri, with = FALSE])
y_train<- df$alsftd_binary[trainIndex]
X_test_raw <- as.matrix(df[-trainIndex, feature_cols_mri, with = FALSE])
y_test <- df$alsftd_binary[-trainIndex]

cat("=== Dataset Split ===n")
cat("Training:", nrow(X_train_raw), "(ALS/FTD:", sum(y_train), 
    "| non-ALS/FTD:", sum(y_train == 0), ")n")
cat("Test:", nrow(X_test_raw), "(ALS/FTD:", sum(y_test), 
    "| non-ALS/FTD:", sum(y_test == 0), ")nn")

# ===== STEP 2: IMPUTATION WITH MICE (proper handling of test set) =====
cat("=== Running MICE Imputation ===n")
set.seed(123)
mice_model <- mice(
  as.data.frame(X_train_raw), 
  m = 30,  # Multiple imputations for robustness
  method = "pmm",
  maxit = 20,
  seed = 123,
  print = FALSE
)
X_train_imp <- complete(mice_model, 1) %>% as.matrix()
# Impute test set properly using mice predict
cat("Imputing test set using training model...n")
X_test_imp <- as.data.frame(X_test_raw)
for (col in colnames(X_test_raw)) {
  if (any(is.na(X_test_raw[, col]))) {
    train_col_complete <- X_train_imp[, col]
    X_test_imp[[col]][is.na(X_test_imp[[col]])] <- median(train_col_complete, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}
X_test_imp <- as.matrix(X_test_imp)

saveRDS(X_train_imp, "results/alsftd_train_set_imp_mice.Rds")
saveRDS(X_train_imp, "results/alsftd_test_set_imp_mice.Rds")

cat("Training set dimensions:", dim(X_train_imp), "n")
cat("Test set dimensions:", dim(X_test_imp), "n")
cat("Imputation complete!nn")
```

### 5.1.1 Hyperparam Tuning

```{r}
# ===== STEP 4: HYPERPARAMETER TUNING WITH STRONG REGULARIZATION =====
cat("=== Hyperparameter Tuning with CV ===n")
set.seed(42)
scale_weight <- sum(y_train == 0) / sum(y_train == 1)

# Define parameter grid to search
param_grid <- expand.grid(
  max_depth        = c(2, 3, 5),
  eta              = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
  min_child_weight = c(1, 3),
  subsample        = c(0.6, 0.8),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.5, 0.7),
  lambda           = c(1, 5, 8),     
  alpha            = c(0.2, 0.5, 1.0), 
  gamma            = c(0, 2, 5, 8)       
)
cat("Testing", nrow(param_grid), "hyperparameter combinations...n")

# Parallel CV
n_cores <- detectCores() - 2
cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
registerDoParallel(cl)

cv_results <- foreach(
  i = 1:nrow(param_grid), 
  .combine = rbind,
  .packages = c('xgboost')
) %dopar% {
  
  params <- list(
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric = "aucpr",
    max_depth = param_grid$max_depth[i],
    eta = param_grid$eta[i],
    min_child_weight = param_grid$min_child_weight[i],
    subsample = param_grid$subsample[i],
    colsample_bytree = param_grid$colsample_bytree[i],
    lambda = param_grid$lambda[i],
    alpha = param_grid$alpha[i],
    gamma = param_grid$gamma[i],
    scale_pos_weight = scale_weight,
    nthread = 1
  )
  
  set.seed(123)
  cv_model <- xgb.cv(
    params = params,
    data = xgb.DMatrix(X_train_imp, label = y_train),
    nrounds = 300,
    nfold = 5,
    stratified = TRUE,
    early_stopping_rounds = 30,
    verbose = 0
  )
  
  data.frame(
    config = i,
    max_depth = param_grid$max_depth[i],
    eta = param_grid$eta[i],
    min_child_weight = param_grid$min_child_weight[i],
    subsample = param_grid$subsample[i],
    colsample_bytree = param_grid$colsample_bytree[i],
    lambda = param_grid$lambda[i],
    alpha = param_grid$alpha[i],
    gamma = param_grid$gamma[i],
    best_iter = cv_model$best_iteration,
    cv_aucpr_mean = cv_model$evaluation_log$test_aucpr_mean[cv_model$best_iteration],
    cv_aucpr_std = cv_model$evaluation_log$test_aucpr_std[cv_model$best_iteration],
    train_aucpr = cv_model$evaluation_log$train_aucpr_mean[cv_model$best_iteration]
  )
}
stopCluster(cl)

# Select best configuration (consider both mean and std)

cv_results <- cv_results %>%
  mutate(
    train_test_gap = train_aucpr - cv_aucpr_mean,
    score = cv_aucpr_mean - 0.5 * cv_aucpr_std - 0.4 * train_test_gap
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(score))
write.csv(cv_results, "results/alsftd_cv_results.csv")
# cv_results <- read.csv("results/alsftd_cv_results.csv")

best_config <- cv_results[1, ]
best_config
cat("n=== Key Metrics ===n")
cat("CV AUC-PR:", round(best_config$cv_aucpr_mean, 3), "±", round(best_config$cv_aucpr_std, 3), "n")
cat("Train-Test Gap:", round(best_config$train_test_gap, 3), "n")
cat("Regularization: lambda =", best_config$lambda, "| alpha =", best_config$alpha, "| gamma =", best_config$gamma, "n")
```

### 5.1.2 Train Final Model

```{r}
cat("n=== Training Final Model ===n")
set.seed(42)
best_params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "aucpr",
  max_depth = best_config$max_depth+1,
  eta = best_config$eta,
  min_child_weight = best_config$min_child_weight,
  subsample = best_config$subsample,
  colsample_bytree = best_config$colsample_bytree,
  lambda = best_config$lambda,
  alpha = best_config$alpha,
  gamma = best_config$gamma,
  scale_pos_weight = scale_weight
)

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(X_train_imp, label = y_train)
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(X_test_imp, label = y_test)

final_model <- xgb.train(
  params = best_params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = best_config$best_iter,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain, test = dtest),
  verbose = 0
)
saveRDS(final_model, "results/alsftd_final_model.Rds")

# ===== EVALUATION =====
pred_train <- predict(final_model, X_train_imp)
pred_test <- predict(final_model, X_test_imp)

metrics_train <- calc_metrics(y_train, pred_train)
metrics_test <- calc_metrics(y_test, pred_test)

# ===== VISUALIZATIONS =====
# Learning curves
p1 <- ggplot(final_model$evaluation_log, aes(x = iter)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = train_aucpr, color = "Training"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = test_aucpr, color = "Test"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = final_model$best_iteration, 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey4", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Learning Curves (Regularized Model)",
       subtitle = paste("Early stopping at iteration", final_model$best_iteration),
       x = "Boosting Iteration", y = "AUC-PR", color = "Dataset") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Training" = "#5f3e7d", "Test" = "#a96ee0")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Performance comparison
results_df <- data.frame(
  Dataset = rep(c("CV (5-fold)", "Training", "Test"), each = 5),
  Metric = rep(c("Accuracy", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "F1", "AUC"), 3),
  Value = c(
    NA, NA, NA, NA, best_config$cv_aucpr_mean,
    metrics_train$Accuracy, metrics_train$Sensitivity, 
    metrics_train$Specificity, metrics_train$F1, metrics_train$AUC,
    metrics_test$Accuracy, metrics_test$Sensitivity, 
    metrics_test$Specificity, metrics_test$F1, metrics_test$AUC
  )
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  mutate(Dataset = factor(Dataset, levels = c("CV (5-fold)", "Training", "Test")))

p2 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Dataset)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.7, color = "grey4", stroke = 0.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(title = "Regularized Model Performance",
       subtitle = paste("Features:", length(feature_cols_mri), 
                        "| Train-Test Gap:", 
                        round(metrics_train$AUC - metrics_test$AUC, 3)),
       y = "Score") +
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("CV (5-fold)" = "#4a4a4a", 
                                "Training" = "#5f3e7d", 
                                "Test" = "#a96ee0")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, align = "hv", labels = "AUTO")
ggsave("Figures/alsftd_regularized_performance.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)

# Feature importance
importance_df <- xgb.importance(
  feature_names = colnames(X_train_imp), 
  model = final_model
) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(Feature = reorder(Feature, Gain))

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = Gain, y = Feature)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#5f3e7d", color = "grey4", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Feature Importance (Regularized Model)",
       x = "Importance (Gain)", y = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = pretty_names) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave("Figures/alsftd_regularized_importance.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)

# ===== SAVE RESULTS =====
performance_table <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("CV (5-fold)", "Training", "Test"),
  N = c(nrow(X_train_imp), nrow(X_train_imp), nrow(X_test_imp)),
  N_Features = length(feature_cols_mri),
  Accuracy = c(NA, metrics_train$Accuracy, metrics_test$Accuracy),
  Sensitivity = c(NA, metrics_train$Sensitivity, metrics_test$Sensitivity),
  Specificity = c(NA, metrics_train$Specificity, metrics_test$Specificity),
  F1 = c(NA, metrics_train$F1, metrics_test$F1),
  AUC = c(best_config$cv_aucpr_mean, metrics_train$AUC, metrics_test$AUC),
  Overfitting_Gap = c(
    best_config$train_test_gap,
    NA,
    metrics_train$AUC - metrics_test$AUC
  )
)

write.csv(performance_table, "Figures/alsftd_regularized_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cv_results, "Figures/alsftd_cv_grid_search_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(performance_table)
```

## 5.2 SHAP Analysis for ALS/FTD

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
shap_train <- shap.values(xgb_model = final_model, X_train = X_train_imp)
shap_test <- shap.values(xgb_model = final_model, X_train = X_test_imp)
shap_long_train <- shap.prep(shap_contrib = shap_train$shap_score, X_train = X_train_imp, top_n = 11)
shap_long_train$Dataset <- "Training"
shap_long_test <- shap.prep(shap_contrib = shap_test$shap_score, X_train = X_test_imp, top_n = 11)
shap_long_test$Dataset <- "Test"

# Combine datasets
col_shared <- intersect(unique(shap_long_train$variable), unique(shap_long_test$variable))
shap_combined <- rbind(subset(shap_long_train, variable %in% col_shared), 
                       subset(shap_long_test, variable %in% col_shared))
shap_combined$Dataset <- factor(shap_combined$Dataset, levels = c("Training", "Test"))

# Apply pretty labels
shap_combined$variable_label <- pretty_names[as.character(shap_combined$variable)]
shap_long_train$variable_label <- pretty_names[as.character(shap_long_train$variable)]
shap_long_test$variable_label <- pretty_names[as.character(shap_long_test$variable)]

# ===== SCALE rfvalue WITHIN EACH FEATURE =====
shap_combined <- shap_combined %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  mutate(rfvalue_scaled = (rfvalue - min(rfvalue, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                          (max(rfvalue, na.rm = TRUE) - min(rfvalue, na.rm = TRUE)),
         median_value = median(value)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ===== PLOT: COMBINED FACETED PLOT WITH SCALED COLORS =====
p_shap_combined <- ggplot(shap_combined, aes(x = value, y = reorder(variable_label, mean_value))) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = rfvalue_scaled), alpha = 0.7, size = 1, shape = 21, color = "grey4", stroke = 0.1,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.025, height = 0.25)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#5f3e7d", na.value = "grey4",
                      name = "Feature\nValue\n(scaled)",
                      labels = c("Low", "", "", "", "High"),
                      breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~Dataset, ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "SHAP Value Comparison (ALS/FTD vs. non-ALS/FTD)",
       x = "SHAP Value (impact on model output)",
       y = NULL) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  # Add annotations
  annotate("text", x = min(shap_combined$value) * 0.7, y = 1, 
           label = "← non-ALS/FTD", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = max(shap_combined$value) * 0.7, y = 1, 
           label = "ALS/FTD →", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

p_shap_combined
ggsave("Figures/alsftd_shap_combined_facets.pdf", width = 10, height = 4)

# ===== PLOT 3: MEAN |SHAP| COMPARISON =====

mean_shap_comparison <- data.frame(
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=13, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
calculate_if <- function(csf_igmL, serum_iggL, qalb) {
  qig <- csf_igmL / serum_iggL
  qlim <- 0.93 * sqrt(qalb^2 + 6e-6) - 1.7e-3
  ifrac <- (1 - (qlim / qig)) * 100
  return(ifrac)
}

# Calculate IF for IgG and for IgA
df$if_igg <- with(df, calculate_if(igglc_ig_g_im_liquor, iggsc_ig_g_im_serum, albqc_albumin_quotient))
df$if_iga <- with(df, calculate_if(igalc_ig_a_im_liquor, igasc_ig_a_im_serum, albqc_albumin_quotient))

df$csf_ratio <- df$if_igg / df$if_iga
df$csf_ratio <- ifelse(df$csf_ratio < 0, NA, df$csf_ratio)

# Now plot IF IgG and IF IgA

  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red2","red3","blue3","orange3","darkgreen","grey40", "grey20")) +
  labs(x = "Diagnosis Label", y = "IF-IgG: IF-IgA", fill = "")
```

# 7 Suppl. Lm interaction

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)

test_age_interaction <- function(biomarker) {
  model <- lm(as.formula(paste(biomarker, "~ alsftd_binary * age_at_report")), data = df)
  broom::tidy(model) %>%
    filter(term == "alsftd_binary:age_at_report") %>%
    mutate(biomarker = biomarker) %>%
    select(biomarker, estimate, std.error, p.value)
}

test_sex_interaction <- function(biomarker) {
  model <- lm(as.formula(paste(biomarker, "~ alsftd_binary * sex")), data = df)
  broom::tidy(model) %>%
    filter(term == "alsftd_binary:sexM") %>%
    mutate(biomarker = biomarker) %>%
    select(biomarker, estimate, std.error, p.value)
}

age_results <- map_df(feature_cols_mri, test_age_interaction) %>%
  mutate(p.adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  mutate(model = "ALS/FTD x age at LP") %>% arrange(p.adjusted)

sex_results <- map_df(feature_cols_mri, test_sex_interaction) %>%
  mutate(p.adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  mutate(model = "ALS/FTD x sexM")%>% arrange(p.adjusted)

sum_tbl <- rbind(age_results, sex_results)

sum_tbl
```

```{r}
make_biomarker_panel <- function(data, biomarker_cols, group_var = "group5", 
                                  fill_palette = group5_fills, ncol = 3) {
  
  plots <- lapply(biomarker_cols, function(bm) {
    ggplot(data, aes_string(x = group_var, y = bm, fill = group_var)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0, alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = fill_palette) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = bm) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8),
        legend.position = "none"
      )
  })
  legend_plot <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = group_var, fill = group_var)) +
    geom_bar() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_palette) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL, nrow = 1)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 10))
  legend <- get_legend(legend_plot)
  panel <- plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = ncol, align = "hv")
  plot_grid(panel, legend, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.08))
}

# Create
page1 <- make_biomarker_panel(data5, biomarkers_page1, ncol = 3)
page2 <- make_biomarker_panel(data5, biomarkers_page2, ncol = 3)

# Export  multi-page pdf
pdf("Figures/mri_biomarker_panel_5groups.pdf", width = 8.27, height = 11.69)
print(page1)
print(page2)
dev.off()

ggsave("Figures/mri_biomarker_panel_5groups_page1.png", 
       plot = page1, 
       width = 8.27, 
       height = 11.69, 
       dpi = 300)

ggsave("Figures/mri_biomarker_panel_5groups_page2.png", 
       plot = page2, 
       width = 8.27, 
       height = 11.69, 
       dpi = 300)
```
